name: Heavy Duty 1000A Fully Insulated Welding Electrode Holder
shortDescription: High-capacity 1000 Amp welding tong with forged brass jaws, heat-resistant DMC insulation handle, and heavy-duty spring for intense SMAW stick welding.
overview: Engineered for high-amperage shielded metal arc welding (SMAW/MMA), this 1000 Amp fully insulated electrode holder delivers superior electrical conductivity and maximum operator safety under high-heat working conditions. Constructed with heavy forged copper-brass alloy jaws, it maintains low contact resistance and accepts electrode rods up to 10 mm in diameter. The ergonomically contoured handle is manufactured from high-impact, heat-resistant Dough Moulding Compound (DMC) with reinforced fiberglass insulation, preventing heat buildup and dielectric breakdown during multi-pass heavy fabrication.
keyFeatures: Heavy-duty 1000A current capacity for continuous high-amperage structural welding
Forged copper-brass alloy jaws for optimum current transfer and minimal resistance heating
Multi-position grooved jaws holding electrodes securely at 45°, 90°, and 180° angles
High-impact, flame-retardant DMC fiberglass insulation resists spatter and heat
Heavy-gauge compression spring provides ultra-firm electrode clamping pressure
Recessed hex-head cable connection with brass ferrule for cables up to 95 sq mm
Ergonomic handle geometry prevents hand fatigue during prolonged production runs

specifications.Connection Type: Hex Socket Screw with Brass Pressure Plate

applications: Heavy structural steel erection and pipe racks
Pressure vessel multi-pass root and cap passes
specsSummary: Current Rating: 1000 Amp @ 60% Duty Cycle / 800 Amp @ 100% | Supported Electrode Diameters: 2.5 mm – 10.0 mm
